title: Run Church encodings
description: This program composes Church booleans and numerals, then decodes selected results for display.

steps.description: The first definitions encode boolean selectors and logic. show_bool and the two helpers decode Church values for Python output.
ZERO, SUCC, PLUS, MULT, and EXP define numeral behavior. The named values compose them into one, two, three, six, and eight.

steps.question: What integer does EIGHT decode to after EXP(TWO)(THREE)?
steps.answer: It decodes to 8, as the comment identifies this expression as 2 to the third power.

steps.description: These prints decode the listed Church numerals and arithmetic results.
The boolean selectors choose between the strings yes and no, implementing if-then-else as application.
ISZERO begins with TRUE and applies a function that returns FALSE once for every numeral step. The loop displays its result for zero, one, and two.
